reason: Avoid repeated authoritative JSONL replay across one real Host prompt admission, including oversized snapshots, without weakening persistence or changing RPC/execution semantics.
compatibility: No RPC/event/journal format changes. Store/AgentRuntime add optional no-op-default admission read scopes. JSONL reuses complete source-validated snapshots only during a scope, with exact fingerprints, per-file locks, normal CAS/full semantic validation and mandatory fsync; scopes confer no authority or lock across awaits. The resident 128 MiB LRU is unchanged; extra transient reuse is separately capped at four scopes and 512 MiB logical bytes per store, with correctness-preserving fallback on quota exhaustion and release on success/error/cancellation. The optional limit can be set to zero. Cold replay and changed files still validate fully. Windows remains required coverage, not claimed complete.
